review_branch_start_rule: start from the final machine-validated B3B09 closeout head; independently reconstruct source, lifecycle ownership, GOV04 tier, cold-start/restart semantics and evidence strength
mandatory_independent_questions: Does frozen revision-53 establish one lifecycle coordinate with accepted Ampl*_act and result/serialized Rsampl*_act aliases?
Is the required read-to-accepted direction Rsampl*_act -> Ampl*_act independently supported by input1, Output_Init, Init and uptake integration dataflow?
Does the existing Inicalc direction erase represented above-threshold actual uptake before first process execution?
Does GOV04 strictest-trigger logic independently force Tier C despite B3 Class B local-correction classification?
Are cold-start and restart semantics correctly bounded given the shared >orgpla initialization surface and absence of a dedicated discriminator?
Are the existing 1.0d-4 threshold, crop trigger and Ipo guard preserved without widening scope?
Is TCD-039 completely excluded from the proposed TCD-038 correction and review claim?
Are STATEQ01 and STATEQ02 evidence kept at their qualified strength and not used as a causally isolated TCD-038 split-run proof?
Are expected differences, downstream consequences, non-interference bounds and residual uncertainties stated without invented tolerances or historical claims?
Does any contradictory or superseding TCD-038 evidence exist at review time?
fail_closed_conditions: restore direction or lifecycle owner is scientifically ambiguous
Tier C prerequisites cannot be independently verified
candidate requires TCD-039 composition or a new state representation
candidate changes numerical policy, solver, tolerance or checkpoint representation
evidence strength is promoted beyond PREP10/PREP12/STATEQ01/STATEQ02 scope
new contradictory or superseding evidence changes the claim
review_may_not: treat current GNU diagnostic evidence as historical B2
